source.note: Dirty listing includes untracked files; diff hash includes tracked files only. Binary SHA256 identifies the tested CD executable.

method.topology: same-host loopback, local relays; auto allows direct discovery and fallback, actual telemetry determines route
method.durability: receiver exit measured separately; timed durable completion adds file fsync and directory fsync equally to both tools. Internal tool fsync differences remain part of native completion.
method.verification: SHA256 every output outside all reported transfer timings
method.cache: warm input/page cache, output deleted after SHA256; sync before each trial; no privileged cache dropping
method.limits: No WAN, packet-loss, browser, concurrency, directory-tree or cross-host claims. tmpfs fsync does not represent physical persistence. croc auto telemetry is textual and does not prove direct routing.
